text:
devon: Quick sketch — I'm experimenting with a compact 'contingency chooser' for rollouts in the console. Goal: let an operator pick a degrade mode fast during noisy incidents without jumping into the full policy editor. thoughts? :eyes:
sara: Love the idea. Can you show the minimum fields you want visible? Operators want confidence it's reversible.
kat: A couple of caveats: 1) must show which triggers match the incoming traffic (so they don't enable the wrong thing), 2) must surface auditability (who clicked, why, and sampling).
mike: +1. Also need to surface quota impact — if we switch to quarantine it might double invocation counts. Quick badge on the chooser: "estimated cost delta: +x%" would be helpful.
devon: Yeah — thinking 3 controls: Mode dropdown, Short duration presets (30s/2m/5m/manual), Silent override toggle. Also a tiny "matched signals" pill list. Sketch pasted: [Mode: quarantine v] [Duration: 2m v] [Silent override: off]  Matched: 5xx, latency>1s, quota-exhaust
james: For audit logs we should include the sampled telemetry breadcrumb id so playback links to the exact trace. Example log entry idea:```{\n  "event":"contingency_apply",\n  "actor":"devon",\n  "mode":"quarantine",\n  "reason":"500-spike",\n  "breadcrumb_id":"cb-2026-03-22-0001"\n}```
kat: That JSON is fine for devs, but UI needs human-friendly text too. Show 'reason: 500 spike on us-east-1 prod' and a link "view sample traces".
sara: UX question: do we allow operators to escalate (soft -> hard) from this compact chooser, or force them to go to full policy editor for escalations?
mike: Maybe allow a one-step escalation but require a short justification text that gets recorded in the audit log. No free-for-all.
devon: Agree. I'll add a "reason (required if changing severity)" input. Also planning to wire in the operator inbox so previous contingency actions are visible.
ops-bot: Deploy preview for chooser available at <https://console-preview.internal/contingency/compact?pr=1294> — note: preview has simulated traffic matching.
kat: Nice — when I clicked the preview matched list showed '5xx (high): 87% of events' which is exactly what we need. Minor nit: make matched signals sorted by impact not alphabetically.
james: One more infra note: the backend needs to emit a deterministic event id so we can replay in the decision-simulator. Avoid random UUIDs for these. Use `contingency:<timestamp>:<policy>` style id.
devon: Good call. I'll switch breadcrumb format. I'll also add an opt-in "attach repro prompt set" checkbox to capture failing prompts for later evals.
sara: This looks like a good MVP. Can you file a short RFC with the mock + telemetry contract? I'll bring it up in next ops sync.
devon: Will do. I'll update the mock with the required fields (mode, duration presets, silent toggle, justification, matched signals, estimated cost delta, breadcrumb id) and link the RFC here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
